picks.reasoning: Stats are noise. GEN has the best lane-winning players in the field, they've been taking games over by themselves all year, and I'm not backing the hyped LPL pick over that.
BLG snowballs the first 15 like nobody else: +1.4k GD@15, 50-12 in series, and they take the first drake and Herald before anyone's even done their first back.
Fearless strips comfort picks, and Gen.G's 88-32 games and a deep, flexible roster across every role say they out-draft anyone once the pool runs dry.
BLG's numbers are the cleanest on the board: 50-12 in series, 125-52 in games, 8-2 against other regions. LPL records aren't directly comparable, so I'm not leaning hard.
Everyone will say BLG or GEN, but KC is a room that just keeps winning together, 40 series wins and a hot finish, and that belief holds when the pressure arrives.
